system.description:
You may make a [Normal Move] of 2 Sq. At this time, if the difference in [Height] of the destination is within 2, the effect can be ignored and moved.

(Minor): The moving distance is +2 Sq. Furthermore, if you finish moving with a Sq. whose [Height] is 3 or more lower than the Sq. that started the moving, add [STR Mod] to the damage roll of a [Melee Attack] of this main process.

A special ability to move over obstacles by handling the body as if ignoring gravity. The enemy will be caught off guard by the approaching attack with an unconventional trajectory.
